features.title: Mail the moment it arrives
features.description: New mail now shows up the instant it lands, not at the next timer check. Wino's relay watches your mailboxes and wakes the app right away. Choose it when Wino asks, or turn it on in Settings > Notifications.

features.title: Sign in with one click
features.description: Sign in to your Wino Account with Microsoft, Google or Apple. There is no new password to remember. Open Wino Account from the title bar or from Settings to try it.

features.title: Ready right after you sign in
features.description: When Wino starts with Windows, it is now ready within seconds of signing in instead of waiting behind other startup apps. Turn it on in Settings > App Preferences.

features.title: Fewer crashes
features.description: We tracked down crashes that only happened in the released app and fixed them across mail, calendar and settings. Unread counts on the taskbar icon show up again too.

features.title: Other improvements
features.description: CalDAV calendars sync faster and handle invitations and attachments. Mail times match your time zone, Gmail and folders are more reliable, settings apply instantly, and Wino now speaks Traditional Chinese.
